profile.headline: Creating human-machine interfaces and cloud-connected apps.
profile.summary: I am a multi-disciplinary developer and engineer with experience at the intersection of medical devices and human-machine interfaces . My goal is to help people through engineering, process, and art. I strive to develop solutions that will aid in making the world a better place for all.

projects.title: Technologies to Train Myoelectric Users for Optimal Outcomes
projects.description:
- Managed project design, timeline, budget, and team
- Acquired electromyography (EMG) control signals and mapped to video game controls
- Wrote software for signal acquisition, processing, and mapping as BLE HID device
- Prototyped embedded system 
- Designed human subjects testing protocol for device testing and validation

projects.title: Two-Degrees of Freedom of EMG-Based Proportional Control in a Hand-Wrist
projects.description:
- Designed and programmed data collection VI in LabView
- Signal processing and data acquisition
- Sensor array (EMG, load cells, force transducers, amplifiers)
- Worked with human subject research participants

publications.title: Prosthetic Jamming Terminal Device: A Case Study of Untethered Soft Robotics
A Pilot Study Assessing Ipsilateral vs. Contralateral Feedback in EMG-Force Models of the Wrist for Upper-Limb Prosthesis Control
publications.publisher: IEEE Signal Processing in Medicine and Biology Symposium · Jan 1, 2015
